Combine the batch normalization (BN, Batch Normalization) layer to the convolutional layer, improve the forward reasoning speed of the model, and reduce the model's PCB defects the training time of the dataset. 2. Aiming at the problem that the objective function and evaluation metric are not uniform in the YOLOv3 object detection algorithm, the GIoU performance metric and loss function are used to improve the detection effect of the model on small and medium targets of PCB defects. 3. Use the K-means++ clustering algorithm to optimize the K-means clustering algorithm, and determine the appropriate anchor boxes for the PCB defect dataset. 4. Multiscale training is used to enhance the robustness of the model for image detection with different resolutions. The experimental results show that mAP (Mean Average Precision) reaches 92.13%, and the detection rate is increased to 63f/s, which is improved compared to the YOLOv3 model, and has a better application prospect in PCB surface defect detection.

articleTitle: Design of the Frequency Modulated Continuous Wave (FMCW) Waveforms, Simulation of the Real Road Scenario and Signal Processing for the Automotive Adaptive Cruise Control
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Power Electronics, Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC) system has aroused much concern nowadays to increase the ability of road scenario indication and enhance the safety of self-driving application. FMCW radar-based technology is the main technique used in ACC system for target detection due to its high resolution and accuracy. The dominating purpose from radar point of view is to observe all the objects within detection range and estimate their range and relative velocity simultaneously and provide all the target information for automotive control system for further processing. A 77GHz FMCW radar system, implementing Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) technology for signal processing, is presented in this paper to detect specific targets in the designed road scenario for automotive application. Basic features of FMCW radar are introduced in detail, along with the process of radar system simulation and waveform generation discussed. The results in regard to targets such as Range-Doppler map are displayed in MATLAB.

articleTitle: Prediction Study of the Heavy Vehicle Driving State Based on Digital Twin Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Power Electronics, Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In order to study the driving state of heavy vehicles, two approaches are employed hereby to establish digital twin models for analyzing the applicable scopes of the models and conducting a predictive study. To begin with, the operating parameters and the state of the vehicles are measured using instruments and apparatuses. Then, relying on a GP and deep convolutional neural network (DCNN), two digital twin models of vehicles driving state are established, respectively, which set the transmission system and power system parameters as well as weather conditions as input parameters; and vehicle running speed and torque value as output ones. Both digital twin models consider the physical rule of the vehicle to avoid overfitting in the training. The analytical results indicate that the GP-based digital twin model appears more accurate in predicting the driving parameters of the vehicles, whereas the model based on the DCNN has better convergence precision within a short span of time. The vehicle-specific digital twin models set up in this paper lay a foundation for subsequent optimization of vehicle driving state and realization of digital twin-physical entity interaction.

articleTitle: Analysis and Design of Inter-provincial Electricity Spot Market Model in China
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Power Electronics, Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: China's administration proposes to carry out reform by taking a province as a unit and gradually establish a market-oriented inter-provincial electricity trading mechanism. Since then, eight provincial spot market pilots have entered the phase of settlement trial operation, and electricity market reform has been widely carried out. On this basis, how to further build the inter-provincial electricity spot market and coordinate with the provincial markets is an important issue in the construction of electricity spot markets in China. Based on mainstream market models abroad, this paper analyzes the trans-regional trading models in Europe and the United States and their inspiration to China. Then it introduces the current situation of construction of a trans-regional electricity spot market in China and analyzes its existing problems. Based on this, combined with the actual situation of dispatching management and operation in China, it is pointed out that the spot market in China shall adopt the market model of “unified market and two-level operation” and adopt the market process of “inter-provincial before intra-provincial The benefits produced by this model are analyzed. The main market framework is designed from three aspects of market participants, trading timing and optimization process. Finally, the key technical requirements for building the inter-provincial electricity spot market in China are abstracted.

articleTitle: One Method for Implementing Privacy Protection of Electronic Invoices Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Power Electronics, Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In view of the fact that the blockchain system is essentially a distributed ledger, the data privacy of electronic invoices needs to be protected, and the electronic invoice circulation environment needs security support, we proposed a privacy protection scheme for electronic invoices based on blockchain technology, a block storage scheme based on three-tier storage such as index/element information summary/electronic invoice encrypted data, and a fast and secure access model based on three-tier storage scheme, which solves the conflict between the openness of blockchain technology and the confidentiality of electronic invoices. Firstly, starting from the background and related knowledge of blockchain technology, we analyzed and studied the availability of blockchain technology on electronic invoices, and analyze the security threats and security requirements of the chain on electronic invoices, On this basis, we designed an electronic invoice system model based on blockchain technology, researched the block storage model and data access logical structure of electronic invoices, and gave the relevant implementation scheme and some pseudo code. Secondly, we analyzed the application scenarios and security of electronic invoices based on blockchain technology; Finally, according to the analysis results of the system, the security, excellence and feasibility of the scheme are proved.

articleTitle: Research on Real-time Object Detection Algorithm in Traffic Monitoring Scene
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Power Electronics, Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Aiming at the detection precision and detection speed of Mobilenetv2-YOLOv3 in the process of object detection, the feature extraction module is improved to improve the network feature extraction capability; the FPN multi-feature fusion module and multi-scale aggregation module are used to enhance information between multi-scale feature maps Fusion; Introduce the dilated convolution to build the receptive field module, Improve the ability to extract features of different scale object, and improve detection precision; According to the characteristics of the KITTI data set, K-means algorithm is adopted for dimension clustering to obtain the new anchor box parameter values. Test the algorithm performance on the KITTI dataset, Experimental results show that compared with Mobilenetv2-YOLOv3, the improved algorithm improves the mAP by 8.99%, and the detection speed reaches 14FPS on the embedded hardware TX2 development board.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Dispatching of DC Microgrid Considering the Demands of Electric Vehicle Users
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Power Electronics, Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Aiming at the different charging demands of EV (electric vehicle) users in the DC microgrid, an economic dispatching strategy of the DC microgrid considering the demand of EV users is proposed. According to the different demands of EV users, the strategy divides EV charging types into four types: instant charging type, flexible charging type, compensation charging type and night charging type. Users upload reservation information through the mobile App one day in advance. According to the reservation information and day-ahead prediction data, the microgrid dispatch center aims to minimize the total operating cost of the system to dispatch the controllable units within the constraint conditions. The charging time of EV is reasonably planned to improve the operation economy of micro-grid. At the same time, it also reduces the charging cost of EV users and improves their enthusiasm to participate in micro-network scheduling. Finally, the economic efficiency and effectiveness of the proposed scheduling strategy are verified by the simulation results of an example.

articleTitle: Campus Behavior Analyses of College Students Based on Large-scale Data
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Power Electronics, Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This essay analyzes the life and learning of some undergraduate students in a college who entered the college in 2015 and graduated in 2019, based on the data collected from the campus smart card system, the education management system, and the library management system. Campus smart cards are widely used in universities, recording a lot of information of the students. On the basis of the overall consumption of campus students, this essay makes detailed analyses of the changing tendency and the reasons involved. From the aspect of consuming information, most of consumption has been found in the canteen. The analysis on the proportion of consuming times is made according to the consumption habits of college students in their three meals in the canteen, followed by the one done on the supermarket consumption, internet fee, electricity and water consumption. Additionally, an analysis is on the differences between boys' and girls' consumption. Another analysis is made on the students' library borrowing loan and proportion with the help of library management system. The educational management system is related to the analyses made from the distribution of students' performance. Finally, according to all consumption, the account of borrowing books and weighted score are found to be correlated to each other. Therefore, we can not only understand the student's behavior characteristics and daily life, but also promote the college logistics service quality, even provide strong evidence for the decision of school management.

articleTitle: An evaluation method of internal network security defense ability based on device traffic
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Power Electronics, Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet technology, the social information level becomes higher and higher. The information system has many safety problems such as data leakage and denial of service besides providing services for the users. How to evaluate the security defense system quantitatively and optimize the deployment of devices, becomes an urgent problem to be solved. Aiming at these problems above, a security defense evaluation method of internal network based on the traffic of devices is proposed. This method quantifies the defense effectiveness, it realizes the objective evaluation on defense effectiveness from two dimensions. One is the severity of potential attack risk, another is the response of a device with defense function. In practical application, this method can evaluate the effectiveness of defense scheme under different application scenes and different security risk defining standards. It doesn't need modeling and analysis for special context separately, and it can evaluate the effectiveness of system's defense strategy quantitatively. Comparing with the method which security staff simulate attack behaviors by penetration testing, this method is more comprehensive and controllable. It is helpful to confirm the relationship between network security device and protected asset, the relationship between security threat and defense, and the relationship between security devices and whole defense system. Through analyzing the evaluation result, the efficiency of the evaluation method of the security defense capability of internal network is proved.
